subject: Compliance refresh: audit readiness & artifact handoff
messages:
From: BrightLine Security <security@brightline.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightline.com
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance refresh: artifact list & timing request

Hi Hannah,

As we approach renewal in late November, our compliance team is kicking off a short SOC 2 refresh. Attached is an initial intake (audit_initial_request.xlsx) showing the artifacts we typically ask for and their preferred delivery windows.

Two asks up front: can Redwood provide (1) confirmation of the snapshot dates you can produce for audit logs and (2) a nod on whether we should expect any throughput/snapshot constraints if we request a 48-hour bulk export in mid-November? We may request a short burst of throughput to capture a representative sample.

Thanks — attaching the intake and a headline timeline. If useful we can do a quick 30-min sync next week.

—Jamie Park
BrightLine Security
security@brightline.com

Attachments: audit_initial_request.xlsx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: BrightLine Security <security@brightline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance refresh: artifact list & timing request

Hi Jamie — thanks for the intake and timeline. We can support the refresh and have sketched a plan below.

Quick answers:
- Snapshot dates: we can produce point-in-time snapshots for audit logs on 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-17 (choose one) and provide an index CSV with checksums.
- 48-hour bulk export: we can enable a temporary throughput burst. We recommend the export window of 2026-11-16 00:00 UTC — 2026-11-18 00:00 UTC to align with our maintenance windows; that gives us time to coordinate caching and KV persistence.

Planned deliverables: artifact_index.csv (will include file paths, checksums, and retention tags), an audit_runbook.pdf with the export steps, and a short SOW amendment for a temporary seat/throughput uplift if you want Redwood to manage the export.

Next steps:
1) Jamie — confirm preferred snapshot date and whether you want the export managed by Redwood.
2) If yes, Ben I’ve looped you for the uplift quote and SOW.
3) Kimberly can confirm retention windows and any log slicing constraints.

I’ve attached the proposed artifact index (stub) and will follow up with the runbook once we lock dates.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: artifact_index.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance refresh: artifact list & timing request

Hannah — quick technical notes from infra:

- Retention: we currently have a rolling primary log retention of 90 days for token-level traces, with archived snapshots retained for 24 months. For the export window you mentioned we can create an immutable snapshot and tag it with the retention horizon.
- KV cache: large model hot caches are ephemeral; for audit purposes we’ll capture the access logs and model metadata rather than trying to capture in-memory state.
- Throughput burst: recommend requesting a 2–3x burst cap for the 48-hour window. Our ops team needs a 72-hour lead to reserve GPUs and I/O bandwidth; Ben please confirm pricing availability.

If BrightLine wants us to run the export (recommended), we’ll produce: an export manifest, checksums, and a runbook describing replayability for the auditors.

—Kimberly
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.com>, BrightLine Security <security@brightline.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance refresh: artifact list & timing request

Hi Jamie / procurement team — copying commercial details into thread.

We can provide a managed export and the runbook. For a 48-hour managed throughput uplift (2.5x baseline) our standard route is a short SOW amendment plus a one-time operational uplift fee. I’ve attached a draft SOW amendment (SOW_amendment_draft.docx) for your review — it includes pricing for a 30k token/hour uplift and an optional 4-week short-term seat increase if you want Redwood to keep the export verifiable on our side during the audit review.

Next steps from procurement:
- Confirm whether BrightLine prefers Redwood to operate the export (we will handle checksums and upload to your secure bucket) or to receive the raw artifacts and run internally.
- If Redwood-run, sign SOW amendment and confirm billing contact for the uplift.

Happy to hop on a 20-min pricing call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_amendment_draft.docx

From: BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLine Security <security@brightline.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance refresh: artifact list & timing request

Ben / Hannah — thanks for the quick responses and the SOW. Procurement prefers Redwood to manage the export and produce the manifest/checksums. Two asks: (1) can you confirm the final uplift price by end of day tomorrow so we can route for internal approval, and (2) can you provide a SOC 2 snapshot (PDF of the report) or link to your latest attestation as part of the package? We’ll need the report to satisfy our audit committee before signing the amendment.

If we lock the 48-hour window on 2026-11-16 we can complete our internal approvals and lock the renewal.

—Maya Ortiz (on behalf of BrightLine Procurement)
procurement@brightline.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.com>, BrightLine Security <security@brightline.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-16T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance refresh: artifact list & timing request

Maya / Jamie — great, appreciate the clarity.

Final confirmations and next steps:
1) Price: Ben will confirm a final uplift estimate (upline by EOD tomorrow). The SOW amendment includes both a managed-export fee and an optional 4-week temporary seat uplift; we’ll mark the optional seat as "add-on" to avoid blocking approvals.
2) Attestation: link to our most recent SOC 2 Type II report: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAuditRunbook (access granted to brightline@brightline.com). We will also include a one-page summary of changes since the prior report.
3) Operational runbook: Kimberly and I will finalize audit_runbook.pdf with step-by-step export instructions and an export manifest template; target delivery 2026-11-02.
4) Lock window: 2026-11-16 00:00 UTC — 2026-11-18 00:00 UTC (please confirm by 2026-10-20 so ops can reserve capacity).

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync for 10/19 with the infra and procurement teams to walk the SOW and runbook.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: audit_runbook.pdf
